name: outbound-engine
description: 19 Claude Code skills that execute the outbound block of a GTM system for B2B service companies (agencies, outsourcing, consulting): signal detection, data research, waterfall enrichment, lead scoring, hypothesis building, sequence copy (email + LinkedIn + subject lines + spintax + follow-ups + PS lines), campaign tiering/naming/orchestration, deliverability audit, A/B test analysis, campaign reports, weekly outreach report, and forensic reply audits. Built and battle-tested by Victor Shulga (Fractional CRO).
